q1_issues.issue: The response event is Skolemized on the apprentice — (sk_reset $a) — instead of on the trigger occurrence $e, so every failure of that apprentice's lanterns derives one and the same reset event During each of them, losing the per-occurrence reading the whenever machinery specifies.

notes: Everything else conforms: indefinite participants route the bare 'when P, Q' to the whenever rule, the of-genitive and the 's-genitive both take Possession (a lantern and a count are not parts of a person), solo_count gets its genus with the non-predicable modifier unexposed, and 'fail'/'reset' take Patient as change-of-state undergoers. Keying the count itself on $a is right — only the event key is at issue.
